name: efs-recover
description: Owner-authorized offline EFS recovery: rebuild a lost EFS certificate/key from an old backup profile (incl. cross/defunct SID) and decrypt + strip encryption from the affected files

setup.note: Create .venv and install dependencies. The setup script detects which Python installer to use (uv, poetry, pdm, pipenv, conda, pip + pyproject.toml, pip + requirements.txt).
